name: FurrIX Vrtual Internet Exchange
notes:
Community-run, hobbyist virtual Internet exchange (vIX) operating under AS218034. Bilateral IPv6 peering and experimental transit across our Kansas City and Düsseldorf edges. Best-effort, non-commercial and built for learning.

While peering is generally open, priority for new session setup is given to fellow hobbyist and research networks. When peering with us, please keep in mind that we are operated by networking hobbyist and our network is treated as a hobby.
